profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer — Mobile | Android & iOS | Mobile Architecture | On-Device AI/ML
profile.summary:
Principal-level Software Engineer specializing in mobile platforms, with 18+ years of experience building production software across Android, iOS, SDKs, backend systems, and cloud-connected architectures.
 
My deepest expertise is in Android and mobile architecture, designing scalable applications and SDKs with a focus on performance, reliability, maintainability, and developer experience. I also bring production experience across iOS and backend systems, allowing me to approach mobile products as complete systems rather than isolated applications.
 
I lead technical direction across teams—from architecture and system design through implementation, engineering standards, CI/CD, performance, and production reliability—while remaining hands-on and mentoring engineers through complex technical decisions.
 
I also work with on-device AI/ML and computer vision, training and deploying models for real-time, offline inference and integrating intelligent capabilities directly into mobile products.
 
Core areas: Mobile Architecture • Android/Kotlin/Jetpack Compose • iOS/Swift • SDK & Platform Engineering • Backend & Distributed Systems • On-Device AI/ML • Computer Vision • Technical Leadership

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer — Mobile & Architecture
positions.description:
- Designed and launched a proprietary onboarding application across Android and iOS, delivering a streamlined KYC experience and improving user engagement by 30%. 
- Led the design and development of native Android and iOS SDKs, establishing reusable mobile architecture that reduced partner integration time by 80%. 
- Expanded the mobile platform across React Native, Flutter, and Cordova, designing integration layers that increased SDK compatibility and adoption. 
- Drove the adoption of on-device machine learning and computer vision, training and deploying models for ID detection and validation that increased automatic KYC processing by 20%. 
- Provided technical direction across mobile initiatives, guiding architectural decisions, engineering standards, and implementation across applications, SDKs, and partner integrations. 
- Contributed to open-source libraries for secure blockchain transaction protocols, extending my work into backend and distributed-system architecture.
positions.insights: Skills: Android · iOS · React Native · Machine Learning · Software Architectural Design · Mobile Application Development

positions.title: Senior Full-Stack Systems Engineer
positions.description:
- Joined Tala as one of its first engineers and the first dedicated mobile engineer, building the MVP Android app used to validate the market in Nairobi, Kenya.
- Architected and led development of the production Android platform, later serving more than 30 million users globally.
- Expanded into full-stack and platform architecture, designing mobile and backend systems to support multiple countries.
- Led the architecture and launch of Tala’s expansion into Mexico.
- Built scalable financial services, payment integrations, pilot applications, and CI/CD pipelines supporting international growth.
positions.insights: Skills: Kotlin · Java · Scala · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Spring Framework · Full-Stack Development · Android · Software Architectural Design · Mobile Application Development

positions.title: Senior Android Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
positions.description:
- Led the development of 3 secure, native Android applications for certificate storage used by US government agencies. These apps leverage industry-standard APIs (KeyChain, Knox SDK, Spyrus SDHC) and utilize FIPS-compliant OpenSSL libraries to meet US government security requirements.
- Built portable FIPS-compliant OpenSSL libraries for Android architectures (armeabi, x86).
- Integrated native Android apps with Rosetta SDHC cards using custom C modules.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Android · Software Architectural Design · Mobile Application Development

positions.title: Senior Android Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led the Migration of existing apps to modern, scalable architectures.
- Built & Maintained robust Android apps, prioritizing user experience. 
- Ensured High Coding Standards across projects, fostering a culture of quality.
- Mentored junior Android engineers, equipping them with valuable development skills.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Android · Software Architectural Design · Mobile Application Development

positions.title: Senior Android Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built a feature-rich cinema app for Android (movie listings, reservations, user accounts)
- Increased online booking reservation by 30% through user-friendly features
- Leveraged location services to display nearby cinemas
- Created a captivating user interface with custom views
- Integrated features like video trailers & QR code scanning for special offers
- Owned the entire development lifecycle (design, development, testing, deployment)
- Employed Agile methodology for flexible project management
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Android · Software Architectural Design · Mobile Application Development

positions.title: Android Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed an Android app to find nearby gas stations, restaurants & attractions.
- Increased user engagement with interactive maps & custom location markers.
- Designed a user-friendly interface for a smooth experience.
- Ensured broad compatibility for most Android devices.
- Streamlined information retrieval and user interaction.
- Implemented a user-friendly system for saving favorite locations.
- Owned the entire development process, from start to finish.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Full-Stack Development · Android · Mobile Application Development

positions.title: Android Full-Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed a comprehensive Android app for all your mortgage needs.
- Helped users find nearby loan officers with interactive maps (Google Maps v2).
- Streamlined information retrieval using RESTful web services.
- Implemented a secure system for storing user preferences (Shared Preferences).
- Enabled push notifications for updates (GCM).
- Supported daily information processing for mortgages.
- Contributed to UI creation and participated in all development phases.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Framework · Full-Stack Development · Android · Mobile Application Development

positions.title: Android Full-Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed a native Android app for locating nearby gas stations, restaurants, and points of interest using web services and Google Maps API V2 for real-time data and navigation.
- Designed and implemented backend APIs to support app functionality, ensuring efficient data retrieval and seamless integration with the frontend.
- Ensured broad compatibility (Android 2.3+) with ActionBarSherlock and optimized performance using Fragments and AsyncTasks.
- Integrated GPS, SQLite, and social APIs (Facebook, Twitter) for location tracking, favorite place storage, and seamless sharing via WhatsApp, Gmail, and more.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Framework · Full-Stack Development · Android · Mobile Application Development

positions.title: Backend Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed two nationwide responsive web apps for Social Security registrations, handling 30,000 daily transactions.
- Built responsive UIs with HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap and backend services with EJB3, integrated with Oracle Service Bus and Hibernate.
- Created secure modules for electronic signatures using applets and Bouncy Castle, ensuring compliance.
- Developed JAX-WS web services, client libraries, and PDF reports with iReport for data presentation.
- Managed full development lifecycle, from requirements to deployment, and proposed technical solutions for scalable modules.

positions.title: Backend Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed a nationwide application for judges and public ministers to manage judgments, reports, and offender data using a decoupled architecture.
- Integrated Oracle products (Service Bus, Access Manager, HTTP Server) and built APIs for seamless system connectivity.
- Designed secure modules for electronic signatures and certificate management, ensuring compliance and data integrity.
- Built web services with JAX-WS (SOAP) and backend services using EJB and Spring, with database design via JPA.
- Created dynamic views using JavaScript, ExtJS, HTML5, and optimized performance with Jingo and DWR.
- Implemented CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins, Maven, and SVN, automating builds, testing, and deployment.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Enterprise JavaBeans (EJB) · MySQL · Spring Framework

company.name: PGR – Procuraduria General de la Republica

positions.title: Backend Software Engineer
positions.description:
SSP is the Homeland Security Agency in Mexico

Developed a nationwide web application to manage information about victims of crime and follow their recovery treatment 
Implemented asynchronous communication to connect to the server using AJAX
Developed web pages using HTML, JSF and IceFaces
Worked some modules with pure JDBC to get better performance in heavy queries
Used iReports to create reports for the victims
Implemented controllers using Spring
Created persistence to database using Hibernate connected to an Oracle RAC
Participated in application development and debugging
Worked with Junit to generate unit test
Implemented programmatically technics to be deployed in a WebLogic cluster with 4 endpoint 


Technologies Used: Java 6, J2EE, JSF 2, IceFaces, Spring 2, Hibernate 1, SVN, Oracle 10g, WebLogic, Linux, AJAX

positions.title: Internship Java Backend Software Engineer
positions.description:
Theoretical and practical training of Java language preparation to get the Oracle Certified Professional Java Programmer 5.0
Performed development tasks using Eclipse and NetBeans IDE
Theoretical and practical training of SQL Server covering topics for get certification of database developer
Worked with MySQL, SQLServer
Reinforcement of the J2EE (Servlets and JSP) and theoretical and practical training of MVC and frameworks
Learned web technologies for implementation in projects
Implemented Java’s framework to learn how they work
Worked in eCommerce application using HTML, JavaScript, AJAX, Spring and hibernate and SQLServer and another one web management staff using JSF, Struts, MySQL and Hibernate.

Technologies Used:  Java, J2EE, Struts 1, Struts 2,  Spring 2, Hibernate 1, JSF 1, HTML, JavaScript, CSS2, SQLServer, MySQL, AJAX, TomCat, PL-SQL, T-SQL

positions.title: Junior C# Backend Software Engineer
positions.description:
Metro is the Mexico City’s underground and over ground transportation Company

Developed a web application for the Mexican subway to control the user’s cards  used to access the subway 
Working with RFID cards to use them like an electronic wallet
Created an web interface to recharge the cards
Created a library to connect the application with the external device to recharge the cards
Implemented interaction with the database using C#
Used ASP pages and .NET framework 3.5 to develop the application and system framework
Participated in development, testing and debugging
Implemented the application in productive environment
Used IIS to deploy the application
Designed and created a database in SQLServer
Worked in a central repository to have control of all access to the subway with cards programed in C#

Technologies Used: C#, .Net Framework 3.5, ASP, SQLServer 2008, IIS

positions.title: Junior C# Backend Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a web application to manage patients and the schedules in the hospital
Developed ASP pages with .Net framework for the application
Interfaced with SQLServer database
Programed the back server with C#
Participated in development, testing and debugging of the application
Used IIS to deploy the web application
Created reports to schedules using iText to generate PDF.
Designed and created database structure and deployed of Database server 

Technologies Used: .Net Framework 3.5, C#, ASP, iText, SQLServer 2008, IIS
